title: Bank accounts as classes
description:
Write a class and a subclass with metatables.

```
Ada: 100
Ada: 70
error: not enough money
Savings Bob: 105 (after 5% interest)
```
hints: `local Savings = setmetatable({}, { __index = Account }); Savings.__index = Savings` makes `Savings` look methods up in `Account` (lesson 5.04).
`error("not enough money", 2)` raises with the caller's position; `pcall(a.withdraw, a, 500)` catches it.
requirements: `Account.new(owner, balance)`, methods `deposit` and `withdraw` (an error for too much), and `__tostring`.
Catch the error with `pcall` and print its message.
stretch: Keep a history of transactions and print a statement.
